symptom: `alter page … { insert after dg column(Name) { column (Attribute: Kind, Caption: 'Kind') { dropdownfilter ddf (attributes: [Status]) } } }` stored attrChoice "auto" with an empty `attr`; check passed and describe printed a bare `dropdownfilter ddf` — #1519 item 2's symptom on the ALTER path, which #1422 named as not done (mendixlabs/mxcli#1519)
cause: buildColumnSpecFromAST (the INSERT/REPLACE column path) built a column's filter with backend.BuildFilterWidget from the widget id and name alone, so no filter property was ever read; CREATE routes the same child through buildWidgetV3 and the filter's .def.json. Routing it through buildWidgetV3 then exposed a second gap: a column REPLACE excluded only the target from the name scope, and ContainedWidgetNames read a column reference only as a data view footer, so a replacement reusing its filter's name was refused as a duplicate
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3_widgets.go` (buildColumnSpecFromAST builds filters via buildWidgetV3), `mdl/executor/cmd_alter_page.go` (column REPLACE excludes what the column contains), `mdl/backend/pagemutator/footerregion.go` (ContainedWidgetNames falls back to findBsonColumn)
insight: When a fix lands in one builder, grep for the OTHER builders of the same node: CREATE and ALTER build Data grid 2 columns through different functions, and the #1422 fix covered one. A path that never registered names cannot collide, so switching it onto the shared builder surfaces the name-scope gap the old path hid — run a REPLACE that reuses the inner widget's name as the control, not just an INSERT.
